title: carex goodenowii subsp. stolonifera
intro: Carex goodenowii subsp. stolonifera, commonly known as Good's sedge, is a subspecies of perennial sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation and pain, as well as supporting respiratory health. The health benefits of Good's sedge are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents have been found to possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities, making Good's sedge a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
